name: sdk-test-node
comment_app-configuration: Pinned to exactly 1.11.0: 1.12.0's connection-string credential sets an invalid request header named 'Connection String' ('Header name must be a valid HTTP token'), breaking this suite. The exact pin keeps a lockfile refresh from moving to it; a Dependabot bump past it fails this suite until the regression is fixed. Revisit when the SDK regression is fixed.
comment_search-documents: At least 13.1.0: 13.0.0 returns an index's ETag as 'eTag' instead of its declared 'etag', so onlyIfUnchanged never sends If-Match, and getDocument double-encodes the $select parameter name (%2524select), so selectedFields is ignored. 13.1.0 defaults to the search api-version 2026-10-01.
